action: Re-base the FY2023 Revenues in the model on continuing operations ($24.61B as now reported, -$8.07B vs $32.68B): the restatement removes Solventum Corp (CIK 0001964738) (8-K items 2.01,9.01, filed 2024-04-04), whose own filings report $8.20B for the period; residual: over-explained by $126.0M (1.6% of the effect).
root_cause: Solventum Corp (CIK 0001964738), the separate registrant behind the disposal MMM reported in its 8-K filed 2024-04-04, reports Revenues of $8.20B for FY2023; add-back: restated $24.61B + Solventum Corp $8.20B = $32.81B vs original $32.68B (gap $126.0M, tolerance 5% = $1.63B); explains 102% of the -$8.07B restatement; residual over-explained by $126.0M (1.6% of the effect); reconciled

evidence.sql:
SELECT cik, first(h._source.display_names[i]) AS name, count(*) AS hits,
       min(h._source.file_date) AS first_date, max(h._source.file_date) AS last_date,
       concat_ws(',', sort_array(collect_set(h._source.form))) AS forms,
       concat_ws(',', sort_array(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(h._source.items))))) AS items,
       max(hits.total.value) AS total
FROM tiresias_sec.fts_d014334df6b92aed_raw
LATERAL VIEW explode(hits.hits) AS h
LATERAL VIEW posexplode(h._source.ciks) AS i, cik
GROUP BY cik
ORDER BY hits DESC, cik DESC
LIMIT 20
